gate_reason: rejected: neither beats champion (h2h 0.53 over 200 games (95% CI 0.467-0.582)) nor improves benchmark (bench 0.054 vs champion 0.065 [within noise]) [health warnings: value estimates reach 2.03, above the reward range; blocks a forced loss only 46% of the time]

diagnosis.meaning: Value estimates have left the reward scale: the Bellman recursion is inflating (target-net lag, lr too high, or shaping rewards stacking beyond ±1).
hypotheses: target_update_every: sync the target net more often (50 -> 20)
if tactical_shaping: cap shaping so |reward| <= 1 per transition
clip Q targets to [-1, 1] at training time (bounded-value lever)

diagnosis.meaning: One-ply tactics are not reliable in one-glance play. The net sees these positions too rarely, or its values at them are muddled by unrelated outcomes.
hypotheses: tactical_fraction 0 -> 0.3 (guaranteed quota of win-available / must-block positions per batch)
train_search_depth 0 -> 2 with search_targets (distill the tactic into the weights — exp-022 is testing this)
tactical_shaping on if off; if on and still failing, the issue is data exposure not reward

diagnosis.meaning: Against perfect-play ground truth the value function is miscalibrated at provably decided positions.
hypotheses: train_search_depth >= 2 (search finds the forced line; distill it)
more decided positions in the buffer (terminal_fraction / tactical_fraction)
